facts.fact: At dusk on the day of the charter, at the gate basket, Sajan self-names to his brother Sanu: Sajan's sleeve touches Sanu's, one low word is spoken to Sanu's face, no speech. The garrison faces the wall and Neela watches only the sleeves. This is Sajan's own once-in-life naming and is separate from Sanu's existing bond to Kandan.

The queen hands each of the three remaining crown-leaf pages to its own guard; Sajan burns his at the gate basket. The queen herself then feeds the 'Sold to the crown' sheet, Chathu's forty leaves and the empty scorched green case into the basket.
Neela's nape trigger dates from the Resin House yard, and it shapes her habit of never letting anyone walk behind her.
